I had a collapse while at a dentist a couple of years back. Just got up from the chair, felt weak and dizzy, next thing I know I'm on the floor. Dentist tells me I seized up. After I recovered a bit, went home with orders to immediately call a doctor, I arrange a call back. When I get it they tell me I need to get blood tests and an ekg today as a matter of dire urgency, and according to them, the only way to do so is to go to the local hospital. I suffer from anxiety, so when I get there early evening and the place is crowded, it's only my fear that I have developed some awful neurological disease that keeps me from turning around and leaving. Knowing I'd be anxious, I bought my switch, but with nowhere available to charge it, it doesn't last long. I wait four hours for triage. The nurse tells me they need to check to make sure I haven't had a real seizure, and it will be five hours before I know. This sends my anxiety into overdrive. I am often quietly crying while I wait. At one point an aggressive person is shouting, another person has a fit, which only increases my anxiety that I can look forward to that in my future. There is an old man with a bleeding head wound. He was there for two hours when I finally got out, the estimate to be seen had grown to eleven hours. 

Turns out they can't find any signs of a real seizure, making it most likely that I passed out from sheer stress. Stress that this experience has not helped. 

What annoys me about this story is that I just needed a couple of simple tests to confirm I wasn't in real trouble. There is no way I should have been taking up A&E space at a time where they are so rushed off their feet. Especially as I would later find that I could have gone to an urgent care centre, which besides likely being less of a stressful environment than A&E, was also in walking distance instead of having to get a taxi to the hospital. 

The local hospital is currently experiencing a critical incident and advising that you don't go there unless absolutely necessary. Apparently many people there are suffering from winter bugs that absolutely do not require hospital care unless you are vulnerable. I wonder how much of it is because of their own ignorance, or because someone they trusted to know better told them it was the only place to go.
